{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fask ranch''' was located thirty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside [[Besia Osurne]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]]. It was run by the Fask family, led by [[Elodd Fask]]. Due to Fask's allegiance to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Rebel operatives used the Fask ranch as a safe insertion point onto the planet, hiding [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the barn equipped with a masking system.
